terms.gloss: Traupman’s phrase for turning a tap on (off)
terms.comment: Varro’s verb is vertere (epitoniīs versīs, RR 3.5.16); reversāre is Late Latin. Turn off with epitonium claudere.

taps.html: Not Traupman’s versāre / reversāre (Traupman 123); reversāre is Late Latin. A house ruling.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 123, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026; p. 313.
